 Supply & apply of water proofing work at  toilet with protective plaster : i. Surface preparation 
and bore packing: Preparing the inside surface of core and in -between PVC pipe by roughening 
using suitable file. Cleaning the surface by wire brushing followed water jet to remove any 
laitance or loose flaky pa rticles. ii. Wall Waterproofing : a. Chipping & cl eaning of  concrete 
surface to remove dust, oil, grease, loose paint/coating. B.Groove cutting at all wall joint for 
making halloring work. C. Applying a coat of styrene -butadiene based polymer coating using 
Nitobond SBR to enhance adhesion between the pack ing material and other surfaces and 
packing the gap using nonshrink cement polymerbased grout using Conbextra GP2 up to the 
top surface of the bore whilst the Nitobond SBR is in tacky state and then sealing with 
epoxy/polyester sealant. iii. Halloring work : in wall joints with Fosroc Hydraproof or Equivalent

membrane) modified mortar. Any cement is required will be supplied by client at free of cost in 
halloring activity. But su bject to reconciliation. iv. Coating Work: 1st day, One coat (1 coat) 
Fosroc Brushbond RFX (High Performance elastomeric cementitious waterproof coating)  
painting on entire surface. v. Next Day:  2nd coat Fosroc Brushbond RFX (High Performance 
elastomeric c ementitious waterproof coating) painting on entire surface. Each coating of 
Brushbond RFX will be 90 degree to each other. (Application will be done as per manufacturer’s 
specification). Sprinkle fine aggregate immediately after the application of second c oat. Cure 
the Brushbond RFX membrane for minimum 3 days as per normal curing practice. Consumption 
of Fosroc Brushbond 5.088 Kg Pack) 12 Sqm – 14 Sqm of each pack. vi. Protective Plaster: The 
waterproofing surface shall be protected with stucco plaster of 3-6 mm. vii. Afterwards curing

subjected to reconciliation basis: **Apply Brushbond RFX in 2 coats to achieve 1mm wet film 
thickness.
